Error identity_unavailable: The daemon cannot tell who the caller is right now.
Fix: Retry shortly; run the command from inside a spur session or as the operator.
Side effects: none
Recovery: Restore caller identity, then run the command again.
Retry: 0 maximum; After fixing the cause.
Docs: docs/errors.md#identity_unavailable
Context: environmentVariable=SPUR_SESSION
Request ID: req-example-123
